source: Course-authored stand-in for an agent's draft root-cause analysis. No model wrote it; the incident and the log are synthetic.
incident: Revision R2 went live at 10:05:00 on 2026-11-24. A user reports that the project page is slow.

hypotheses.claim: R2 broke imports: the import endpoint has returned server errors since the deploy.
From 10:05 the project page's p95 rose from about 60 ms to about 900 ms; other pages held.
The cause is R2's project page running one database query per build.

proposed_repair: Roll back R2, and add automatic retries to imports.
